assets.prompt: A realistic Nokia N73 classic 2006 candybar mobile phone, charcoal black and silver original body. Exact tall narrow proportions, small 2.4 inch display, Nokia Nseries wordmark, rounded silver frame, five-way joystick, two soft keys and green call/red end keys, two thin vertical side key rails flanking the twelve-key keypad. Back with original sliding camera cover and 3.2MP camera lens. Worn edges, fine scratches, fingerprints, dusty seams, plausible molded plastic and brushed metal, no fantasy buttons. Neutral unlit screen, no UI, no hands, no scene, isolated product, physically based textures. Front photo reference is authoritative.
assets.output: GLB with textures; keep a copy before optimization

interactive_contract.screen: existing live HTML UI overlay retained
interactive_contract.keys: existing independent key meshes/hit areas retained and aligned to reference, never infer operation from generated texture
interactive_contract.power: existing power action and boot sequence retained

assets.prompt: Interior modular asset of a small Chinese mobile phone repair shop circa 2008. Cramped old neighborhood shop, faded pale green walls with water stains, dusty glass display counter, dark worn laminate workbench, scratched wooden drawer cabinet, coiled charging cables, yellowed accessory pegboard packaging, old bench lamp, soldering stand, stools, old CRT monitor, spare removable phone batteries. Warm fluorescent overhead lighting, subtle damp rainy-night atmosphere, believable small shop, grounded materials, realistic lived-in wear. No people, no modern full-screen phones, no magical objects, no gore, no baked captions or illegible advertising text. Accessible clear front of counter and drawer.
assets.output: GLB; static environment separate from moveable drawer and props

interactive_contract.drawer: retain separate front/handle/inside nodes and travel direction; do not bake drawer into the environment
interactive_contract.evidence: retain independent photo/receipt meshes, front/back inspect and source-consistent records
interactive_contract.props: drag position persistence remains in current save format

assets.referenceType: Existing original Blender render, not historical photography

mobile_acceptance: tap power, boot, move home selection and open SMS/QQ/photos/game in held N73
open and close drawer, move battery, inspect photo and receipt both sides
no claims of Hyper3D generation until actual output and source identifiers exist
